I can give you recommendations for current indie, EDM, and (some) folk music.

• Phantogram - pretty standard pop-tronica, but still good. Entry level.
  • Deadmau5 - popular EDM/House music. Has a lot of longer, more gradual tracks that are quite good.
  • Mastodon - sludge metal from down South. Really good.
  • Sufjan Stevens - crazy good folk artist. His most recent album, Carrie & Lowell, is amazing.
  • Phoenix - Indie rock.
  • Ratatat - Straight rock, like Led Zeppelin but with a phatter bassline, no blues and no lyrics.
  • Perturbator - Recent synthwave (derives a lot from 80's music)
  • Tame Impala - Psychedelic rock.
  • Glitch Mob - Like Deadmau5 but a bit faster.
  • Neon Indian - Synthy pop, really kinda darker and a bit... smoky.
  • Ariel Pink - Unique indie music, about as indie as it gets. One of my favorite albums of his is Pom Pom.
  • Thievery Corporation - Incorporates bossa nova and buddhist melodies into their music.
